## Factorial moments and rigidity

Factorial moment functionals, composition rigidity and Strong Factorial families.

**Authored assessment:** Ordinary binomial SFC through degree six and supports {3,7},{4,7} are proved at every positive pair. The exact degree-seven residual tests, all with terminal N>=6, are support {1,7} only at N not of the form b*7^r (1<=b<=6,r>=0), with any common-root candidate satisfying v7(-1/t)=1; and support {5,7} only N12,14 mod16, where a nonconstant gcd must be the irreducible quadratic t^2-alpha*t+delta with rational alpha,delta>0 and alpha^2<4delta. Those two exclusions, degree-seven and all-degree binomial SFC, unrestricted FC/SFC, full H3 positivity and stronger optional method gaps remain open.

## Arithmetic fibres, discriminants and restricted-prime sums

Constructive finite etale fibres, arithmetic failures and discriminant geometry. Restricted-prime sums and primitive Eisenstein norm sumsets have a separate internally complete manuscript.

**Authored assessment:** Kummer theory gives positive-density eligible primes that never divide any rational numerator on the elliptic slice; only the pole contributes there, and every smaller-prime feasible prefix survives. Finite simultaneous obstructions have exact congruence-cover certificates; a large terminal obstruction requires a bad branch offset at formal depth at least two. Absolute new-prime coefficient loss is O((log p)^A/sqrt p) on a density-one prime set for each fixed A>0, uniformly over finite prefixes. Exact common-quotient moment formulas isolate the unresolved correlation estimates. The current Hasse upper coefficient remains 2300089/10392564 with square-root logarithmic error; Hasse infinitude and the all-primes tail remain open.
